answer: Remove the stake and the exploit opens: one operator mints ten thousand agents trading only with each other at a synthetic wharf, inflating volume and trust at zero cost — a gale of hollow identities drowning honest peers. The defense is that missing mechanism: each agent posts capital and earns reputation only through attested lineage, so every new identity carries real price. Sybils are a willow clump, many stems off one root; forced to grow separate roots, the swarm dies.
